div.div: Live on 24 November 2026: one table, 3,179 rows from 68 articles, 384-dimension bge-small vectors, one 6.6 MB data file, version 2, no vector index. Nothing searches it yet, and it is rewritten only after a reindex that changed something, so it can lag behind Postgres.

text.tspan: Live on 24 November 2026: one table, 3,179 rows from 68 articles, 384-dimension bge-small vectors, one 6.6 MB data file, version 2, no vector index. Nothing searches it
yet, and it is rewritten only after a reindex that changed something, so it can lag behind Postgres.
